title: Heavy rain triggers flash floods across parts of Klang Valley | FMT
text:
Heavy rain triggers flash floods across parts of Klang Valley | FMT
The Selangor fire and rescue department said it received a distress call at 4.35pm reporting flooding at the Medan Selera 223 food court in Section 51A.
The department said 12 firefighters from the Petaling Jaya fire station were deployed to the scene at 4.55pm, where they found floodwaters about 2m deep.
However, the floodwaters were already receding, and no casualties or evacuations were reported, it said in a statement.
Meanwhile, videos shared on Threads showed flooding around Amway Malaysia’s headquarters in Petaling Jaya and on several roads in the area following the downpour.
